message:
I'm consistently getting empty outputs from all my tools. This suggests there may be an issue with the environment or the tool execution. Let me try one more approach - using the str_replace_editor to view the workspace directory.

<｜｜DSML｜｜tool_calls>
<｜｜DSML｜｜invoke name="str_replace_editor">
<｜｜DSML｜｜parameter name="command">view</｜｜DSML｜｜parameter>
<｜｜DSML｜｜parameter name="path">/workspace</｜｜DSML｜｜parameter>
<｜｜DSML｜｜parameter name="view_range">[1, 50]</｜｜DSML｜｜parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜invoke>
</｜｜DSML｜｜tool_calls>
